title: The crisis of 1929
goal: Say what had already happened before the crash of 1929, with the pluperfect.

items: I can say what had already happened before another moment in the past, with *había* + past participle.
I can say what happened on the Wall Street stock exchange in October 1929.
I can explain why the crisis reached Latin America.
I can use the words *la bolsa*, *el préstamo*, *la deuda* and *el arancel*.
